samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative/generative math task. Petrel leads on every public benchmark and internal eval (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7, plus stronger math/reasoning signals via MMLU-Pro and GPQA), and Plover self-reports an aversion to high-latitude generative work like "invent the whole setup yourself." This is an open-ended generative task (invent a problem from scratch) plus light math reasoning. Petrel leads on every relevant measure — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7), and substantially stronger reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) that matter for solving the problem correctly. Additionally, Plover self-reports an aversion to high-latitude generative work, while Petrel has no such preference; with capability equal-or-better on Petrel, there's no reason to assign the task to the model that disprefers it.

Creative Generation evals are effectively tied (within variance), so Petrel is the better fit on both capability and preference grounds.
